pr_title: ADR-0112 wave-A: webhook-receiver kernel + app (HMAC + dedup + router)
summary: F8 observability/operations review for PR #7: webhook routing exists, but production authentication, delivery durability, and dispatch diagnosability are not fail-closed; 3 actionable findings, highest severity BLOCKER.

findings.issue: HMAC verification is skipped whenever skip_hmac is false but no secret is loaded; startup also retries without the secret after SecretIo. A missing/misconfigured webhook secret therefore accepts unsigned production webhooks.
findings.remediation: Make missing secret a startup error unless --skip-hmac is explicitly set, and add tests for HTTP mode rejecting unsigned deliveries when the secret path/ref is absent.

findings.issue: Accepted/routing-failed HTTP deliveries are not appended to webhook-delivery-log.json. The receiver loads an initially empty log, returns a response, and leaves no durable delivery, dedup, or failure evidence for incident replay.
findings.remediation: Append every delivery outcome with delivery_id/event/action/outcome/timestamp using atomic/locked writes, and cover accepted, deduplicated, expired, routing_failed, and agent_invocation_failed paths.

findings.issue: Routing returns an agent name/purpose but does not invoke the dispatcher or persist a dispatch request. Operators see HTTP 202 Accepted without proof that the Foundry agent actually received work.
findings.remediation: Emit a durable dispatch queue/event row after route_event succeeds, record dispatcher outcome, and write agent_invocation_failed rows when invocation cannot be confirmed.
